hooks.command: curl -s -m 1 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:${TNG_BRIDGE_PORT:-3791}/turn-start" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "$(cat | jq -c '{transcriptPath: (.transcript_path // "")}' 2>/dev/null || echo '{}')" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

curl -s -m 2 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:${TNG_BRIDGE_PORT:-3791}/compaction-start" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "$(cat | jq -c '{trigger: (.trigger // "unknown"), transcriptPath: (.transcript_path // "")}' 2>/dev/null || echo '{}')" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

curl -s -m 2 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:${TNG_BRIDGE_PORT:-3791}/session-start" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "$(cat | jq -c '{transcriptPath: (.transcript_path // "")}' 2>/dev/null || echo '{}')" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

curl -s -m 2 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:${TNG_BRIDGE_PORT:-3791}/compaction-end" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "$(cat | jq -c '{transcriptPath: (.transcript_path // "")}' 2>/dev/null || echo '{}')" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
